result.summary: The intersection features modern pedestrian infrastructure including wide, newly paved sidewalks, tactile warning strips, and marked crosswalks. However, the wide roadway and large corner radii suggest a design that prioritizes vehicle throughput, resulting in long crossing distances for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Wide corner radius
hazards.description: The large radius of the corner allows vehicles to make right turns at higher speeds, increasing risk to pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground corner where the new sidewalk meets the road.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge, increasing their exposure time to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: The marked crosswalk spanning the main roadway.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway to shorten the crossing distance and tighten the turning radius.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

result.summary: The intersection is equipped with high-visibility continental crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and a median refuge island. However, the wide multi-lane roadway and suburban design suggest a high-speed environment that increases pedestrian exposure and risk.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic, increasing their time of exposure to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: High-Speed Roadway Geometry
hazards.description: Wide lanes and a lack of vertical traffic calming elements encourage higher vehicle speeds through the intersection.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic receives a green light.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Tighten Corner Radii
interventions.description: Reduce the radius of the corners to force turning vehicles to slow down.

result.summary: The image depicts a large, multi-lane signalized intersection with a marked crosswalk but no pedestrian refuge islands. The environment is characterized by long crossing distances and high-speed roadway geometry, which significantly increases pedestrian exposure and risk.

hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross at least six lanes of traffic in a single stage, increasing exposure to vehicles.

hazards.name: High-Speed Intersection Geometry

result.summary: The image depicts a wide, multi-lane arterial intersection with high-visibility crosswalk markings but significant crossing distances. The environment is heavily car-oriented, lacking visible pedestrian signals and protected refuge areas despite the presence of a median.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
